reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: So hydrating! This mask feels luxurious on my face and has become a staple in my routine. I use it the night before retinol to make sure my skin is fully hydrated before the retinol treatment. My skin feels noticeably softer and plumper after one use. It gives a healthy, dewy glow without feeling heavy or greasy.
reviews.zh: 超級保濕！敷上面感覺好奢華，已經成為我日常必備。我會喺用 retinol 之前一晚敷，確保皮膚有足夠水分先去 retinol 護理。用一次之後皮膚明顯軟嫩咗、飽滿咗。俾到一種健康嘅水光感，唔會厚重或者油笠。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Wanted to try this mask as I love the toner and wanted a simple mask for days when my skin is feeling sore for tret. The value pack with the sunscreens was a good way to try. Makes great gift as well. Easy all rounder.
reviews.zh: 因為我鍾意佢哋嘅爽膚水，所以想試吓呢款面膜，喺用 tret 之後皮膚覺得痛嗰啲日子用就啱晒。連防曬嘅套裝抵玩，值得一試。送禮都好適合。簡單全面嘅選擇。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: I really like this Round Lab mask. It only needs 10 minutes, which is super convenient, and it doesn’t have a strong smell — it feels very natural and gentle on the skin. The texture and absorption are great, and overall it feels really good to use. I’ll definitely buy it again.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款 Round Lab 面膜。淨係敷 10 分鐘就搞掂，超方便，而且冇乜香味，感覺好天然、對皮膚好溫和。質地同吸收都好好，整體用落好舒服。一定會再買。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: I love round lab products as it uses natural ingredients! I decided to try this as it seemed to have such great reviews! Again, round lab did not disappoint. This sheet mask fits well on my face without having to stretch it. It does not have a strong scent so it is good for sensitive skin. The product is slightly watery and is able to be absorbed quickly into my skin. After using this sheet mask, I find that my skin appears more radiant and hydrated and my skin feels softer and smoother too.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意 Round Lab 嘅產品，因為佢用天然成分！見評價咁好就決定試吓。Round Lab 從來都冇令我失望。呢款片狀面膜貼面度好，唔使拉扯。冇乜香味，敏感肌都啱用。精華稍微水狀，可以好快被皮膚吸收。用完之後皮膚望落更有光澤、更保濕，摸落都更軟更滑。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Great adhesion and moisturizing for my sensitive combination skin. I really like material of mask too. I would repurchase once I finish. Mask also soothes my skin and cools it down. I like to use at end of work week to relax and pamper myself
reviews.zh: 我係敏感混合肌，呢款貼服度同保濕度都好好。我都好鍾意面膜嘅質地。用完會回購。面膜仲可以舒緩和降溫皮膚。一個禮拜做完嘢，我就會用嚟放鬆下、寵下自己。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: まだ使えてませんが、評価もいいので期待してます。オリグロさんはクチコミの更新が出来ないので評価3つにします。
reviews.zh: 雖然仲未用到，但評價睇落唔錯，所以都好期待。Oligro 嗰邊唔可以更新用後感，所以評分俾 3 星。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Love them but not as hydrating as the cica ones from round lab. Oh, warning for those who use first time, mind that you need to peel off the film after putting the mask onto the face. Put the mask on the right side. Don’t be dump like me😂
reviews.zh: 鍾意，不過保濕度就唔及 Round Lab 嘅 cica 系列。溫馨提示第一次用嘅朋友，記住敷上面之後要撕走嗰層保護膜。記住敷返啱嘅方向。唔好好似我咁蠢 😂

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Hydrating Water Gel Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: I have bought four more boxes so that I have these masks in stock. This is one of the best. I am using it in the morning and at bedtime when I am not too tired. Made my skin very hydrated and I Basically did not need any moisturizer after the mask. Highly recommended.
reviews.zh: 我已經再買多四盒囤住。呢款係數一數二好用。我朝早同臨瞓前（如果唔係太攰嘅話）都會用。皮膚變得好保濕，基本上敷完之後唔使再搽保濕霜。高度推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
